Irugapadaṇḍanātha
son of Daṇḍanātha Baicappa, minister of King Harihara an. Bukka of Vijayanagar. Inss. of his are d. A.D. 1382, 1386 an. 1383. See South Ind. Ins. I. 152 (p. 156), Epi. Ind. VII. p.. 115 an. 116.
--Nānārtharatnamālā ascribed to him; probably written for him by Bhāskara. Ed.. Deccan Col.. Res. Inst. 1954. The Ekākṣarakāṇḍa separately noted (Pejawar 105 (d)) is the opening section of this work.

Irugapanātha
name of Uddaṇḍa, the author of Mallikāmāruta, a. stated in the work.
